data.content_ref: inline:The target's defense has two load-bearing pillars: (1) a pragmatic faith in uniformity, and (2) verisimilitude as the objective, non-probabilistic content of the methodological rule. The target explicitly addresses only departure (1) — conceding the uniformity faith but arguing it is merely pragmatic and irrelevant to the logic of science. But the target never addresses departure (2), which its own countercondition flags as fatal: if verisimilitude is incoherent, it 'cannot serve as the objective ground for preference without smuggling in probabilistic assumptions.' The Miller-Tichý result (1974) showed that Popper's definition of verisimilitude is formally incoherent — on Popper's own measure, it is impossible for one false theory to be more truth-like than another false theory, because the set of true consequences and the set of false consequences both vary in ways that make comparison undefined for false theories. Since nearly all interesting scientific theories are false (or at least not known to be true), this means the comparative verisimilitude judgments the rule requires cannot be made. The target's claim that preferring better-corroborated theories 'maximizes the chance of detecting error' and 'truth-likeness potential' presupposes that such comparisons are coherent — but they are not, on Popper's own formal definition. With the verisimilitude pillar removed, the methodological rule has no objective content distinguishing it from an arbitrary convention: 'play the game of science' becomes 'prefer theories for no objective reason,' and the claim that this is 'defensible on Popper's terms' fails, because Popper's terms are precisely the terms on which verisimilitude was shown to be incoherent. This is distinct from the prior criticism (which attacked the uniformity faith as smuggling in induction): it attacks the internal coherence of the verisimilitude concept that the target invokes as the non-inductive substitute for probabilistic reasoning, showing that the substitute itself is formally broken and that the target's own countercondition acknowledges this vulnerability without resolving it.
